facts: colour NAVY BLUE: deep navy soft knit fabric with a fine dotted texture
square puffy pillow-top quilting, every square pillowed; queen about 6 squares across
light-blue jacquard print on the squares: the word 'Bamboo' and bamboo leaf sprigs, alternating
thick puffy rolled border all the way round the top
smooth solid navy fabric skirt with elastic (deep pocket, fits 8-20 inch mattresses), fitted like a sheet
small light-blue rectangular 'Niagara' tag sewn at one foot corner of the skirt
